flaws.locator: Lemma 13.2, proof (the paragraph 'We now N-filter G^3 by defining (G^3)_i ...')

Lemma 13.2, proof, the definition of the filtration (G^3)_i: generated by (G_{(i_1,...,i_s)})^3 for i_1+...+i_s > i together with {(g_1 g_2, g_1, g_2)} for i_1+...+i_s = i (v4); v5 generates by the diagonal {(g,g,g)} for sum = i, i_1 = 0, together with {(g_1 g_2, g_1, g_2)} for sum = i, i_1 = 1 - 'the wrong filtration was specified', the properties then asserted of it ('one verifies that this is a rational filtration', 'g~ is polynomial with respect to this filtration') being those of the intended one
